headline: Fans are NOT ready for this
post:
Yellowstone alum Luke Grimes shared that since his onscreen dad Kevin Costner was killed off the series, the two have "never spoken," according to USA Today. The actor noted that this is "not for any other reason other than we are both just busy guys and life moves on."

Despite not keeping in touch since the fifth and final season in 2024, Grimes mentioned it "would be cool" to have his former co-star return in a flashback scene, though he doubts that will happen at this point. Instead, he feels a flashback with his on-screen wife might be more poignant for his character.

What are your favorite memories from watching this iconic ranch family on television?

#Yellowstone #LukeGrimes #KevinCostner
original_title: Yellowstone's Luke Grimes Reveals Where He Stands With Kevin Costner

headline: Fans are talking about this quick recovery
post:

headline: New claims emerge in Cornell lawsuit
post:
Legal representation for the woman who accused former Cornell University fraternity members of gang rape has shared new allegations regarding the aftermath of the incident. According to her attorney, Thomas Giuffra, fraternity members reportedly held meetings to coordinate their response and protect their reputation.

Jane Doe filed a lawsuit last month against the school, the fraternity, and seven former members, alleging she was drugged and assaulted in 2024. The New York Attorney General is currently overseeing an ongoing investigation into the matter.

What are your thoughts on how universities handle these sensitive cases?

#Cornell #UniversityNews #LegalUpdate
original_title: Cornell Rape Accuser's Attorney Claims Fraternity Held Meetings to Cover Up Alleged Rape
